_comment: Gates the MATLAB driver CANNOT measure, and therefore does not silently
omit: they run in another language binding, under another compiler, in
another repo, or against a historical pre-fix engine binary that no
longer exists in the tree.  Each entry records the command that produces
it and the date it was captured; the report labels every one of them as
externally sourced, with that date, so a reader can tell at a glance
which numbers `make polval-regen` refreshed and which it did not.
Update protocol: re-run the command, paste the result here, bump
'captured'.  Do NOT copy any of these into the report prose -- the prose

X_MMACOS_SUITE.note: fast 289 / masks 62 / freeform 46 / proper-512 10 / proper-1024 13; gfortran-linked mex, engine at the r_p sign fix

X_PYMACOS_SUITE.gate: pymacos pytest suite (ifx-linked = the standing ifx smoke)

X_PROPER_RESIDUAL.gate: ladder 3 -- polarized PROPER re-run reproduces the committed scalar residual EXACTLY, for both polarization-off and polarization-on/vector-off
X_PROPER_RESIDUAL.note: re-confirmed in the 2026-07-27 re-run: unchanged in results_phase2/report.md and results_phase3/report.md

X_PROPER_VECDIFF.gate: ladder 3 -- vector run differs from scalar on the Coro near-field leg at identical total power; attribution UNVERIFIED

X_GMI.gate: GMI regression -- polarization work must be a no-op on polarization-off prescriptions

X_PREFIX_FF_TOTAL.gate: ladder 5 -- far-field vector total power BEFORE the PFFPROP->FFPROP*3 unification
X_PREFIX_FF_TOTAL.command: rebuild the engine with propsub.F at a0f6dba^, then re-run the ladder-5 case
X_PREFIX_FF_TOTAL.note: HISTORICAL. Requires rebuilding the pre-fix engine; not reproducible from the current tree. The post-fix counterpart (G35_VECTOR_TOT) IS regenerated every run.

X_PREFIX_VECCHAIN.gate: non-vacuity -- the pre-fix engine FAILS the vector-chain gates
X_PREFIX_VECCHAIN.command: rebuild the engine with propsub.F at a0f6dba^, then run tVecChain
X_PREFIX_VECCHAIN.note: HISTORICAL. 0.21 after one leg, 0.38 after two.

X_PREFIX_POWER.gate: non-vacuity -- the pre-fix engine also mis-states total power
X_PREFIX_POWER.command: rebuild the engine with propsub.F at a0f6dba^, then run tVecChain

X_SPSIGN_CAPTURED.gate: capture date of the pre-fix A/B below
X_SPSIGN_CAPTURED.command: copy macos_f90/elemsub.F aside, restore the pre-fix RP form (the '! fixed by jzlou' line), makems.sh release gfortran, relink the mex, run tPolarization -k odd_mirror; then restore the copy and rebuild

X_SPSIGN_PREFIX_RESID.gate: pre-fix median relative residual vs the perfect-conductor closed form (max 1.61e+05)
X_SPSIGN_PREFIX_RESID.command: copy macos_f90/elemsub.F aside, restore the pre-fix RP form (the '! fixed by jzlou' line), makems.sh release gfortran, relink the mex, run tPolarization -k odd_mirror; then restore the copy and rebuild
X_SPSIGN_PREFIX_RESID.note: model 128, Rx_Cass_FarField, same rays as G41

X_SPSIGN_PREFIX_RADIAL.command: copy macos_f90/elemsub.F aside, restore the pre-fix RP form (the '! fixed by jzlou' line), makems.sh release gfortran, relink the mex, run tPolarization -k odd_mirror; then restore the copy and rebuild
X_SPSIGN_PREFIX_RADIAL.note: flat -- no slope-driven effect can be

X_SPSIGN_PREFIX_SLOPE.gate: pre-fix log-log slope of cross-pol vs pupil radius
X_SPSIGN_PREFIX_SLOPE.command: copy macos_f90/elemsub.F aside, restore the pre-fix RP form (the '! fixed by jzlou' line), makems.sh release gfortran, relink the mex, run tPolarization -k odd_mirror; then restore the copy and rebuild

X_SPSIGN_PREFIX_RET.gate: pre-fix spurious retardance from a perfect conductor
X_SPSIGN_PREFIX_RET.command: copy macos_f90/elemsub.F aside, restore the pre-fix RP form (the '! fixed by jzlou' line), makems.sh release gfortran, relink the mex, run tPolarization -k odd_mirror; then restore the copy and rebuild

X_SPSIGN_PROBE_PRE1.gate: PRE-fix cross-polarized power fraction after ONE mirror
X_SPSIGN_PROBE_PRE1.note: model 256; the driver's own G42_PYPX1 is the model-128 post-fix value

X_SPSIGN_PROBE_POST1.gate: POST-fix cross-polarized power fraction after ONE mirror

X_SPSIGN_PROBE_PRE2.gate: PRE-fix cross-polarized power fraction after TWO mirrors

X_SPSIGN_PROBE_POST2.gate: POST-fix cross-polarized power fraction after TWO mirrors -- bit-identical to the pre-fix value

X_SUITES_CAPTURED.gate: date the three cross-checking suites were last re-run together
X_SUITES_CAPTURED.note: a hand-typed date in the prose is the same hazard as a hand-typed number

X_POLELT_TWOCHAIN_RAY.gate: ray-level power at the detector with crossed polarizers, engine wired into tracesub.F ONLY
X_POLELT_TWOCHAIN_RAY.command: revert the propsub.F CPROPAGATE dispatch for TrPolarizerElt/WavePlateElt (leave only the tracesub.F chain), makems.sh release gfortran, relink the mex, then trace Rx_PolElt.in with crossed polarizers and compare sum|RayE|^2 at the detector against sum(macos.intensity(7))
X_POLELT_TWOCHAIN_RAY.note: model 128, Rx_PolElt.in; the companion grid number is X_POLELT_TWOCHAIN_GRID

X_POLELT_TWOCHAIN_GRID.gate: detector-PLANE integrated intensity for the same crossed-polarizer state -- the full incident power, i.e. the grid saw no polarization at all
X_POLELT_TWOCHAIN_GRID.command: revert the propsub.F CPROPAGATE dispatch for TrPolarizerElt/WavePlateElt (leave only the tracesub.F chain), makems.sh release gfortran, relink the mex, then trace Rx_PolElt.in with crossed polarizers and compare sum|RayE|^2 at the detector against sum(macos.intensity(7))
X_POLELT_TWOCHAIN_GRID.note: model 128, Rx_PolElt.in; equals the analyzer-aligned value, which is the point
